NL.U_window_note: area-weighted average of all windows and doors; 2.2 for a single element
NL.note: Bbl new-build minimums (Rc in m2K/W); confirmed by IPLO and in a 2026 tool run

FI.note: Reference values for permits from 2018 (decree 1048/2017 Table 1)

DE.note: GEG Anlage 1 reference building. Not maximums: the real house must not use more primary energy than this reference.

AT.note: OIB-RL 6 point 4.5.1 table. Window 1.4 and wall 0.35 seen in 2025 university slides; roof and floor from 2019/2023 energy certificates. The Tirol 2025 guide says these maximums are far from enough for a zero-emission building (about 0.15 opaque and 0.8 windows needed).

IE.note: TGD L Dwellings Table 1, area-weighted average elemental U-values (same table in the 2022 edition and the 2025 consultation draft)

DK.note: BR18 par. 257 (minimum requirements) and par. 258 (windows: energy balance, no U limit)

ES.note: CTE DB-HE Tabla 3.1.1.a-HE1, climate zone D (Madrid): walls and floors to outside air 0.41, roofs 0.35, elements against ground or unheated spaces 0.65, windows (frame + glass + shutter box) 1.8. Read in the DB-HE PDF 2026-11-12.

Htr_vars.theta_an: mean annual outdoor temp, clamped 7-11 C

SI.note: TSG-1-004:2022 par. 8.1.6: no element maximums, only a limit on whole-envelope transmission loss H'tr (W/m2K). Formula read from the PDF layout; fraction placement to be checked.

HR.note: NN 128/15 Annex B Table 1, heated >=18 C, coldest month <=3 C (continental); 'coastal' = coldest month >3 C. Later amendments (70/18, 102/20) keep wall 0.30 and roof 0.25 per a municipal source; window not rechecked.

SK.note: STN 73 0540-2 (paid). The standard's author (Sternová, TZB-info 2013) lists target values U_r2 that became the normalized values from 2021: wall 0.15, flat/low-pitch roof 0.10, ceiling to unheated space 0.15. Windows: the same article gives 0.60 for the 2012 edition, a Velux note on the +Z1+Z2 edition gives 1.00 for 2021; 1.00 is used.

HU.note: 9/2023 (V. 25.) EKM Annex 1 point 1.1 (window 1.1 = wood/PVC frame >0.5 m2; floor 0.30 = slab on ground, new buildings)

BE-WAL.note: PEB Umax since 2021 (AGW annex C1); seen in the Wallonia PEB leaflet, Test-Achats and 2021 PEB reports

BE-BRU.note: Same Umax as Wallonia per Test-Achats (all three regions); Brussels annex not read

EE.note: No element limits; only the ETA energy requirement
